messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail.

message.content: {"animals": ["axolotl", "pangolin"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A large stout salamander-like creature shown in right-facing side view with a thick elongated body, four short muscular legs, and a long tapering tail. Its skin is smooth but deeply wrinkled and ribbed along the flanks, gray-brown above fading to pale cream below. The head is broad and flat with a rounded snout, large round dark eyes, a thin smiling mouth slit, and tiny nostrils at the tip. Behind the head are six long tapered external gill stalks, three per side, bearing dense pink feathery filaments. Along the back and sides are three distinct patches of overlapping rounded brown plate-like scales. The tail extends to the left with a low dark fin-like ridge along its upper edge.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "broad flat rounded snout with smooth mottled gray-brown skin", "part": "head", "where": "at the front of the body facing right"}, {"looks_like": "large round black eyes with pale bluish rims", "part": "eyes", "where": "on the sides of the head"}, {"looks_like": "thin curved slit forming a slight smile", "part": "mouth", "where": "across the front and side of the snout"}, {"looks_like": "two tiny dark dots", "part": "nostrils", "where": "on the tip of the snout"}, {"looks_like": "long tapered gray stalks with dense pink feathery filaments", "part": "gills", "where": "three behind each side of the head, with three visible on the near side and three sticking up behind on the far side"}, {"looks_like": "thick barrel-shaped body with deeply wrinkled ribbed gray to cream skin", "part": "torso", "where": "in the middle between the head and the tail"}, {"looks_like": "overlapping rounded brown keratin plates with fine striations", "part": "scales", "where": "in three patches on the upper back and on the sides behind the gills and above the hind legs"}, {"looks_like": "short thick muscular limbs with wrinkled gray skin", "part": "legs", "where": "two under the chest and two under the belly supporting the body"}, {"looks_like": "broad splayed toes with long slender digits tipped with small dark claws", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the legs on the ground"}, {"looks_like": "long thick tapering muscular tail with smooth skin and a low dark fin fold along the top", "part": "tail", "where": "extending to the left behind the body"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
